name: helpText
meaning: description string for the item under the cursor, refreshed by Map_GetHelpText

name: scrollText
meaning: the help-text scroller of mode 4: Map_UpdateState calls ScrollText_Init / ScrollList_Update on this+4 and Map_Draw calls ScrollText_Draw(this+4, 2, 1) at 0x54169c

name: pulseColorFast
meaning: cosine-modulated tint 0x808080<->0x3040E0 used for the mailbox markers

name: pulseColorSlow
meaning: slower cosine tint passed to the MapLocation "you are here" marker draw

name: panelFrom
meaning: start rect of the animated description panel as one contiguous {x,y,w,h}: 0x527772 lerps +0x24 and +0x28 together into a single stack rect that Map_DrawPanel consumes, so it is one field, not a panelFrom/panelFromWH pair at +0x24/+0x28

name: panelTo
meaning: target rect of the animated description panel, one contiguous {x,y,w,h}; 0x5276bd is called on +0x2c and +0x30 as a pair immediately before each lerp

name: pulsePhaseFast
meaning: 12-bit angle advanced by g_dtRawMs*12 each frame

name: pulsePhaseSlow
meaning: 12-bit angle advanced by g_dtRawMs*4 each frame

name: scrollTop
meaning: index of the first visible inventory row

name: cursorIndex
meaning: selected inventory row (absolute, not windowed)

name: selectedClassId
meaning: class id of the item under the cursor; fed to Map_GetHelpText and Map_HighlightLocationsForZone

name: prevCursorIndex
meaning: cursor position before the current move, used to repaint the old row

name: actionIndex
meaning: selected action button 0=HELP 1=USE 2=COMBINE/SPLIT 3=EXIT

name: prevActionIndex
meaning: previous action button, repainted to 0x808080

name: combinePartnerIndex
meaning: row latched as the first half of a combine while mode 3 is active

name: helpTimerMs
meaning: tooltip countdown, armed to 3000 and decremented by g_dtRawMs

name: markerTimerMs
meaning: mailbox-highlight countdown, armed to 6000 and decremented by g_dtRawMs

name: listBaseY
meaning: virtual-screen Y of the first item slot; starts 0x80 then shifted up by half the list height

name: autoRepeatMs
meaning: auto-advance timer for the transient modes (bit 7 of mode set); any d-pad press forces it to 0x96

name: wipeHeight
meaning: height of each curtain bar during the open/close wipe, stepped by +7 per FRAME

name: swapPending
meaning: 1 while a combine partner has been picked and the second item is being chosen

name: mode
meaning: sub-mode inside state 3: 1 item list, 2 action row, 3 combine pick, 4 help scroll; bit 0x80 = transient/auto-advance

name: pendingMode
meaning: mode committed when autoRepeatMs expires

name: itemCount
meaning: number of inventory classes present in this level

name: visibleCount
meaning: rows shown at once, min(4, itemCount)

name: locationCount
meaning: number of Mailbox markers found (max 5)

name: phaseCounter
meaning: per-FRAME counter for the opening (15 down) and closing (15 up) holds; also drives the global fade level as phaseCounter/2

name: scrollDir
meaning: mode-4 help scroll direction for this frame: 0, -1 while UP is held, +1 while DOWN is held (Pad_MenuHeld at 0x540c46 / 0x540c64); passed to ScrollList_Update(this+4) at 0x540c87

name: closeCounter
meaning: per-FRAME counter for state 5; at 5 it calls SelectMenu_RestoreFlags, at 10 it moves to state 6

name: state
meaning: select-menu state 0 closed, 1 opening wipe, 2 opening hold, 3 interactive, 4 closing hold, 5 closing wipe, 6 closing tail, 7 suppressed

name: resIcons
meaning: resource id lists: [0..7] = four action-button icon pairs (HELPB/HELPA, USEDB/USEDA, COMBB/COMBA, EXITB/EXITA), [8]=IGLCADG_ item frame, [9]=IGLFLEC_ arrow, [10]=IGLCADH_ button frame, [11]=IGLCERC_ marker, [12]=IGLTRIA_

name: actionText
meaning: button labels, indexed by actionIndex: UI strings 0x24, 0x23, 0x25, 0x03

name: actionTextSplit
meaning: UI string 0x49, substituted for actionText[2] when the selected item is composite

name: markers
meaning: cached Mailbox markers, 0x20 bytes each

name: inventoryClassIds
meaning: class id of each inventory row, in scan order

name: backdrop
meaning: the DAV_IDI_MAP bitmap laid out as a five-piece nine-slice: top bar h=0x30, left column 0x60x0xA1, right column 0x30x0xA1, centre panel {0x60,0x30,0x170,0xA1}, bottom bar h=0x1F

name: scrollArrow
meaning: up/down list arrows drawn from IGLFLEC_ at x=0x18, above and below the item list

name: actionSlots
meaning: the four action buttons, 0x44 bytes each: +0x00 u8 enabled, +0x01 u8 highlighted, +0x04 u32 tint

name: itemSlots
meaning: the four visible inventory slots, same 0x44 layout
